problems.title: Authentication required
problems.meaning: Bearer authentication is missing or invalid.

problems.title: Authorization failed
problems.meaning: The caller, request context, or requested resource is not permitted by authorization or access policy.

problems.title: Resource not found
problems.meaning: The requested resource does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

problems.title: Validation failed
problems.meaning: Request payload, parameters, manifest, or metadata failed validation.

problems.title: Invalid manifest
problems.meaning: A submitted volume.toml is structurally or semantically invalid.

problems.title: Invalid archive
problems.meaning: A submitted hosted archive violates the v0.1 archive transport profile.

problems.title: Identity mismatch
problems.meaning: A package identity disagrees with its route, manifest, or metadata.

problems.title: Version conflict
problems.meaning: The target version already exists or cannot be reused.

problems.title: Digest mismatch
problems.meaning: Submitted or resolved bytes do not match the declared digest.

problems.title: Subject binding mismatch
problems.meaning: A trust artifact does not bind to the intended release subject.

problems.title: Inconsistent registry state
problems.meaning: Index, exact metadata, or trust metadata cannot be reconciled.

problems.title: Upload expired
problems.meaning: An upload intent expired before finalization.

problems.title: Missing uploaded bytes
problems.meaning: Finalization was requested before upload bytes were available.

problems.title: Invalid upload state
problems.meaning: The upload intent is not in a state that can be finalized.

problems.title: Idempotency conflict
problems.meaning: A reused idempotency key conflicts with an earlier request.

problems.title: Payload too large
problems.meaning: The submitted payload exceeds the bibliotheca's accepted limit.

problems.title: Unsupported media type
problems.meaning: The submitted payload media type is not supported.

problems.title: Permission escalation
problems.meaning: Component permissions exceed the parent volume permission boundary.
